items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Marian McPartland has been down there with her trio... I believe maybe Marian and Jimmy McPartland and some of the guys.

ctx.x: Does he still have an interest in that club?
No. I don't think he nor Tommy have an interest. They may have maybe a few residuals, but I don't think so. I think they sold out.
And I have no idea. It's been through several hands since that time.
